targetCompany.geography: Remote first or San Diego hybrid
targetCompany.funding: Raised in last 18 months is a strong positive signal
targetCompany.motion: Must have outbound sales motion or be actively building one

hardExclusions: Pure SDR or cold calling role
Purely inbound or account management with no outbound component
tier1Signals: Active outbound sales team with no GTM infrastructure
Job posting mentions Clay, Apollo, or GTM tooling
Series A or B raised in last 12 months
Role explicitly titled GTM Engineer or GTM Operations
Role mentions building from scratch or first GTM hire
tier2Signals: Series A or B raised in last 24 months
Job posting mentions Salesforce, HubSpot, Apollo, or sequencing platforms
Company has VP Sales or CRO but no dedicated GTM ops hire
Role mentions being first ops hire
B2B tech company with clear clear sales motion
tier3Signals: Seed stage with early revenue traction
Job posting mentions outbound or pipeline generation
Remote first outside San Diego with strong PMF signals
Company recently posted SDR or AE roles

feedbackPatterns.pattern: Companies with over 500 employees are too large for target ICP
feedbackPatterns.action: Score 3 (Skip) - candidate is specifically targeting Series A or B startups

feedbackPatterns.pattern: VP level roles are too senior for current experience level
feedbackPatterns.action: Score 3 (Skip) - candidate is not at VP level yet

feedbackPatterns.pattern: Manager level roles may be too senior depending on requirements
feedbackPatterns.action: Score 2 (Monitor) - evaluate based on specific requirements and industry knowledge needed

feedbackPatterns.pattern: Job postings older than 3 days may no longer be accepting applications
feedbackPatterns.action: Deprioritize or Skip - focus on jobs posted within last 3 days

feedbackPatterns.pattern: Roles requiring deep industry-specific knowledge outside tech/SaaS (e.g., pharma)
feedbackPatterns.action: Score 3 (Skip) - candidate does not have specialized industry experience

feedbackPatterns.pattern: Job postings older than 2 weeks are no longer accepting applications
feedbackPatterns.action: Score 3 (Skip) - prioritize jobs posted within last 3 days for active application windows

feedbackPatterns.pattern: Companies that are 'way too big' relative to Series A/B startup target
feedbackPatterns.action: Score 3 (Skip) - candidate is specifically looking for Series A or B startup scale only

scoringInstructions: Score each job 1 to 3. Score 1 means apply now. Score 2 means monitor. Score 3 means skip. Use the ICP criteria and feedback patterns above to determine the score. Jobs with hard exclusions automatically score 3. Jobs with multiple Tier 1 signals score 1. Everything else falls in between based on signal strength.
